title: Enzymatic Disaggregation of Human Myometrium for 10X Single Cell RNA-seq
author: Aymara Mas
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bb5miq46
materials: Uterine tissues should be transported in preservation solution (HypoThermosol® FRS) at 4 °C from the surgery room to the lab.

steps.title: Rinse sample with wash buffer
steps.instruction: Rinse the tissue sample with wash buffer to remove blood and mucus.

steps.title: Isolate myometrial layer
steps.instruction: Place wet tissue under a petri dish and, using a sterile scalpel, remove the endometrium, serosa, and laser‑burnt zones to isolate the myometrial layer.

steps.title: Mince tissue into <1 mm³ pieces
steps.instruction: Mechanically chop and mince the isolated myometrium into small pieces smaller than 1 mm³.

steps.title: Incubate tissue in enzyme buffer overnight
steps.instruction: Transfer the minced tissue to 50 mL Falcon tubes containing 30 mL enzyme buffer, tighten the lids, seal with parafilm, and incubate horizontally at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension through 100‑50 µm filters
steps.instruction: After incubation, filter the cell suspension through a series of 100 µm to 50 µm polyethylene filters to remove clumps and undigested tissue.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtered medium at 400 × g for 5 minutes (temperature not specified), discard the supernatant, and add at least 1 mL resuspension buffer (volume may be adjusted based on pellet size).

steps.title: Optional RBC lysis with ACKL buffer
steps.instruction: If a red‑blood‑cell ring is visible after centrifugation, add ACKL lysis buffer, incubate for 5 minutes at 37 °C, then repeat the filtration step onward.

substeps.instruction: Proceed again with filtration (step 5) and subsequent steps.

steps.title: Digest extracellular DNA with DNAse I
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL DNAse I to the suspension, mix thoroughly by pipetting, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Filter through 40 µm strainer and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Add at least 1 mL resuspension buffer, filter the mixture through a 40 µm cell strainer, then centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 minutes (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Resuspend final cell pellet
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in at least 1 mL resuspension buffer (volume adjusted to pellet size).

steps.title: Enzymatic dissociation with Tryple Select
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL Tryple Select Enzyme to the resuspended cells, mix thoroughly by pipetting, incubate for 10–15 minutes at 37 °C, then centrifuge at 300 rpm (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Count cells on two counters
steps.instruction: Count the total number of cells at least twice using two different cell counters.

steps.title: Optional cryopreservation in freezing medium
steps.instruction: If desired, resuspend cells in freezing medium to a concentration of 1 × 10⁶ cells per mL and store in cryogenic vials.
